items._cn_summary: 这张专辑记录了阿拉巴马州杰斐逊县Sterling Jubilee Singers的现场排练，这支成立于1929年的非裔美国人无伴奏四重唱由伯明翰的矿工和纺织工人组成。录音捕捉了1994年他们在一间紧邻铁路线的厅堂中的排练场景，成员在曲目之间祈祷，展现了这一濒临消亡的民间传统的真实面貌。制作由阿拉巴马民俗协会主持，旨在记录该团体每周维持高水准演唱所经历的严格训练过程。四重唱的演绎精致而富有层次，标准曲目编排繁复，人声和谐度极高。对于远离美国南方文化语境的人来说，这是一扇通往另一种音乐宇宙的窗口，呈现了非裔美国人福音音乐对后来各种流行形式的根基性影响。该唱片由Death Is Not The End发行，属于其关注边缘民间传统的一贯路线。

items.body:
Mija Milovic's 2023 album 'Still Life' on Escho. 

"Textures and sounds spanning from the virtues of 90’s grunge/alt-rock to renaissance-like melodies bound together with the opposite pop-music structures sliced with contemporary collage techniques. A sentence almost as wild as the music, yet ever so familiar, like a band dreaming of each other."
items._cn_summary: Mija Milovic 的专辑《Still Life》由独立厂牌 Escho 于 2023 年发行，将九十年代垃圾摇滚与另类摇滚的质感融入文艺复兴风格的旋律线条中，并以与流行音乐结构相反的方式进行切割重组。整张作品运用当代拼贴技法，将不同时代、不同来源的素材并置，形成对比鲜明的听觉体验。评论将其描述为一支乐队在彼此的梦境中相遇，意指声音素材之间既陌生又熟悉的张力关系。专辑在传统摇滚根源与实验拼贴手法之间寻找平衡点，呈现出解构与重构并存的创作思路。

items.body:
In their sublime duo debut the simpatico synth & guitar of Jonny Nash & Tomo Katsurada is seduces to blissed, wind-whispering soundscapes, hashed out over the course of 12 months since Katsurada lent strings to Nash’s ‘Once Was Our Forever’. Dream material FFO Ghost, Makoto Kawabata, Joanne Robertson...

"Netherlands-based artists Tomo Katsurada (Ex-Kikagaku Moyo / Future Days Radio) and Jonny Nash (Melody As Truth) combine forces for an exploration into the sonic potential of the guitar duo, rooted in their experiences performing together over the last 12 months.

Friends and admirers of each other’s work for a decade, their musical collaboration began in 2024 with Katsurada asking Nash to contribute guitar to his debut EP ‘Dream Of The Egg’. Sensing the need to explore this further, they spent the following year performing together in different configurations, with Nash joining Katsurada’s trio and Katsurada in turn playing with Nash as a duo, across a wide spectrum of spaces, from churches and temples to concert halls, theatres and outdoor festivals. With new ideas developing organically out of these performances, recording new material became the next logical step. A short period of three days was set aside with a clear goal: to capture the essence of their fluid, intertwining melodies and guitar playing in a way that felt as direct and unfiltered as possible. Working from a handful of pre-existing sketches, they left ample room for experimentation to unfold within the process.

The results are presented on ‘At The Emerald Pool’, a collection of ten pieces that offer the listener a full immersion into the pair’s sound. With guitar as the primary instrument for both artists, it is no surprise that the core of the album lies here, specifically in the fluid interplay between the two players. Layers of gentle, delay-soaked fingerpicking often make it almost impossible to distinguish where one player ends and the other begins. As soloists, both Katsurada and Nash have a gift for crafting melodic lines that feel open and ascending, expressive and hopeful without becoming saccharine. Longer, more abstract pieces are counterbalanced by a series of shorter songs, with five vocal tracks appearing across the album. The decision to share vocal duties lends the record a unique quality and a strong sense of variation, bringing a wide expressive range out of a deliberately focused musical framework.

‘At The Emerald Pool’ represents the first chapter in an ongoing musical dialogue, an attempt to capture a moment of connection, openness and discovery, laying the foundation for what continues to unfold."

items._cn_summary: 此专辑为荷兰吉他手加藤友朗与乔尼·纳什的二重奏首作，记录两人在教堂、庙宇、音乐厅等多元空间合作后，用三天时间快速完成的十首作品。核心以两把吉他为核心，通过大量延迟效果的指弹技法，使两人的旋律线条彼此缠绕融合，难以分辨各自的边界。在即兴框架下，短小歌曲与长篇抽象段落交替出现，五首人声曲目由两人分担主唱，丰富了整体表现维度。两人相识十年后才正式开启合作，专辑定位为持续音乐对话的起点，强调捕捉当下感受与开放氛围，而非构建宏大叙事。加藤此前活跃于Kikagaku Moyo、Future Days Radio等组织，纳什经营Melody As Truth厂牌，使作品带有独立民谣、电子氛围与即兴音乐的混合气质。整体氛围倾向于静谧、低饱和度的声景探索，适合偏好冥想式聆听的听众。

Five more choice cuts from Kenyan icon + the "king of Kikuyu Benga" Joseph Kamaru's back catalogue. Chosen by Disciples and Joseph Kamaru’s grandson, KMRU.

"A companion mini-album to Heavy Combination, last year’s career-spanning compilation documenting some of the amazing music recorded over five decades by the late Joseph Kamaru, a towering figure in post-colonial Kenyan culture. This new record presents five more gems from the archives, chosen by Disciples and Joseph Kamaru’s grandson, the sound artist KMRU. items.body:
Gorgeous DIY, private press, lounge jazz and Latin boogie stardust from 1984, framing keyboard maestro Ronald Langestraat in his living room, laying down pure vibes to 4-track - huge tip FFO Lewis, Gil Scott Heron, James Mason, Starship Commander Woooo Wooooo.

"Searching was self-recorded in Ronald’s living room on a 4-Track Tape Recorder in 1984. The recordings symbolise his engagement to cross-over everything that was known to him musically at that time. Most importantly, all recordings reflect his personal way of searching; searching for his own characteristic sound. Rhythmical patterns meet well balanced distortion, shaping the music into a mirror of his character. He was part of several Dutch Latin and Jazz bands, including Cascada and Ritmo Natural. With the latter he performed at Holland’s North Sea Jazz Festival. At this point Ronald is 78 years old, playing music every day.

Instruments: Acoustic Piano, Fender Rhodes Piano, Farfisa Organ, String Ensemble, Tenor Sax, Alt Sax, Soprano Sax, Clarinet, Alt Clarinet, Organ Bass, Micro Moog, Drums, Longa & Voices.”
items._genre: DIY private press / lounge jazz / Latin boogie / lo-fi
items._cn_summary: 这张1984年的私人出版作品由荷兰键盘手Ronald Langestraat在家中以四轨磁带录音机独立完成。专辑呈现lounge jazz与Latin boogie的融合，Rhodes钢琴、Farfisa风琴、Moog合成器与萨克斯、clarinet等乐器交织出温暖而私密的质感。录音方式极为原始，4-track格式赋予作品独特的lo-fi颗粒感与即兴氛围，节奏模式与精心调节的失真相互映照。作为DIY私人压片，其稀有性和手工感本身就具有收藏价值，艺术家如今78岁仍在每日演奏，为这张早期作品增添了一层时间纵深。整体而言，这是一张融合爵士传统与拉丁律动的小众私人制作，风格偏向休闲放松，与极端实验或学院派即兴距离较远，但对热衷于挖掘罕见私人出版爵士的听众而言具有独特吸引力。

items.body: Austin-based composer/sound designer TJ Dumser (Six Missing) returned to roots for drift, sway—eschewing scale for intimacy in a minimal set mixing guitar loops and vintage synths with tactile timbres to create soundscapes for deep listening, reflection and filmic ambience. Subtle textures drifting in and out The recent drift, sway finds Six Missing forging what TJ Dumser describes as ‘a space where sound becomes a gentle pulse—drifting through the air like a breeze, swaying like light on water’ with pieces that purportedly ‘emerged from a meditative state, a process of dissolving into repetition, texture, and resonance,’ built ‘not […] as songs, but as movements—fluid, organic, breathing.’ Following previous releases from his ambient, meditative and cinematic project (cf. Gentle Breath, 2025), Austin-based composer/sound designer Dumser returned to roots for drift, sway—eschewing scale for intimacy in a minimal set mixing guitar loops and vintage synths with tactile timbres to create soundscapes for deep listening, reflection and filmic ambience. ‘Music for presence, for focus, for the quiet spaces within,’ he puts it, and with guitar primary he ‘let loops and delay pedals guide [him] into a trance-like flow, where melodies formed like ripples in stillness.’ A resonant realization :: Set-up/deployment (Gearhead alert!): Boss DD-20 (in 16-sec looper mode)—a vessel for layering evolving motifs; MTL.ASMLY Count to Five, Meris Mercury 7, EarthQuaker Devices Avalanche Run, Analogman King of Tone, Boomerang Looper—to shape the edges of sound into something soft yet infinite; Moog Minimoog, Korg Polysix—subtle textures drifting in and out, their warmth and imperfection breathing life into the minimal framework. The album is in two movements: Drift—six weightlessly hovering pieces reflecting the ebb-flow of thought, memory and dream; Sway—four pieces embracing stillness in motion, ‘the way we lean into presence without holding too tightly,’ the artist proffers. Overall drift, sway constitutes a resonant realization of this and the artist’s various meditative reflections. drift, sway is available on Nettwerk [Bandcamp] drift, sway by Six Missing  The post Six Missing :: drift, sway (Nettwerk) first appeared on Igloo Magazine.
items._cn_summary: Six Missing 的《drift, sway》是一张以冥想为核心的氛围专辑，作曲家 TJ Dumser 回归简约路线，将吉他循环与复古合成器结合，运用多重延迟与循环效果器层层叠加纹理。整张专辑分为两部分：上半段六首作品以失重感漂浮的音色呈现思维与记忆的流动；下半段四首作品以静态中的微动表达专注与当下感。制作上大量使用 Boss DD-20、Meros Mercury 7 等吉他效果器与 Minimoog、Polysix 等模拟合成器，使音色兼具温暖的有机感与电子的延展性。整张作品强调重复、纹理与共鸣的缓慢演化，适合深度聆听与冥想场景，在器乐氛围与电影配乐感之间取得平衡。

items.body: Review by tszirmay — This sublime group has rather rapidly taken over top spot as my favourite Spanish Prog band, a nudge beyond Rafael Pacha, only due to the impeccable quality throughout their 5-album discography, from 1997's debut "Transformation" up to today's subject matter, "Seven Hills'. Only one personnel change to announce, drummer Miguel Diaz replaces Marco Anderson, the remaining cast revolving around the incredible guitarist Raul Mannola, fluid keyboardist Denis Bilanin, Nill Oliveira on elastic bass, and Juan Carlos Aracil providing flute, a perfect detail to their flamboyant jazz-rock/fusion stylistic. While some pundits will undoubtedly mention the Mahavishnu Orchestra as an influence, I am afraid I will not take that well-trodden path, as there are some overt differences, namely the preponderant Spanish colorations as well as the soft sheen of the flute which transport the stylistics into a parallel universe perhaps by still 'miles away' from the legendary combo. One common point to note, is all five instrumentalists are exceptionally talented, and Raul Mannola is undoubtedly going to stun a few guitar fans into abject awe.The title track wastes little time in settling the listener into a comfortable mindset, a vivid reminder of just how manicured the interplay between them has endured over the years. Nearly 10 minutes of supple instrumental cohesion, the rhythm section setting the breezy pace , a musical travelogue of sorts where each instrument has a voice and a reason. The Aracil swirling around the divine, the electric guitar dancing along until it finally decides to break off the tender embrace and venture out of the comfort zone, the piano switching into rousing organ alliance that gets the juices flowing. The insanity has only just begun, as Raul rips to shreds his fretboard with raging bull fury, adding velocity to the anger, the flute coming to the rescue as if to heal the open wounds. Up to Bilanin to reveal his Brian Auger fetish with a rousing Hammond spotlight, just as intense as the axe assault, Oliveira and Diaz thrashing mightily along for the ride. What a slap in the face, I feel refreshed already ! My beloved e-piano appears to lead the band on "Blues for LC" , a tribute perhaps to either Larry Carlton or Larry Coryell (perhaps both), eventually shoring the line-up into the heady groove, a platform for Mannola, Aracil and Bilanin to trade massive slices of flurries, one wilder than the other. A slow burn finale puts out the fire, but gently. Oliveira gets to initiate the next arrangement, his eventful bass guitar lighting up the runway on "Day Five", nudging along his bandmates into a jungle feast of notes, where dense musical fruits hang from the surrounding trees, each musician picking theirs at random, savouring every bite. Bilanin goes on a piano splurge, cymbals akimbo, as if racing through an Amazonian clearing. When the bass pops, the brain gasps in delight. What an exhilarating thrill.Diaz has his turn introducing the choppy "Feel the Cool Wind ", a temperamental breeze that may switch into a gale at any moment, the flute keeping the suspense alive and well. The electric guitar first carves a swath of oblique patterns, almost Picasso-esque, until the bass and flute decide to reembrace once again, the prefect opportunity for Raul to play mind games with a wide variety of playful interventions, capturing perfectly the idiosyncrasies of an upcoming storm. The insatiable e-piano returns for another romp in the wet fields, reminding one of a Brazilian dude called Deodato. Fun. "No Return" has Raul featuring his acoustic guitar skills, a Spanish tradition to say the least, and his spot is exemplary, ably assisted by a brash rhythmic pulse, eventually revving up the engines, a slow and deliberate electric build-up that aches to explode. The only negative is that I could have enjoyed another 10 minutes of this! "Wise Raven" is definitely a finale to crow about (sorry, I had to!), a 9 minute + masterclass in bluesy jazz-rock that pretty much serves to sum up what this band has to offer. Like the petulant bird, the track is altogether brash, cocky, even pesky at times, the insistence verging on mania, with endless ebb and flow, push and pull. The Aracil flute figures to once again behave like a soothing nurse, allaying any fears that madness may prevail. Does not stop the playing to be fast and furious. The scintillating electric guitar rant gets bullied along by that throttling keyboard undertow, and Raul just takes off into the wild blue yonder. Diaz even gets to pummel his kit with notorious abandon, as if playing in concert and earning applause. Forty-one minutes of unrelenting action, emotion, spills and thrills. Que maravilla! This is a band wholly deserving of major recognition, keeping the legendary spirit of past-jazz-rock greats smiling with appreciation from above (Chick, Jaco, Joe, Wayne, Larry, Allan etc..). Muchas gracias, senores! 4.5 clear lights

items.body: Review by Fercandio46 — Formed in 2007 and hailing from the post-hardcore scene, the Spanish band Toundra emerged as a breakout act in Spain's underground scene and performed at the 2010 Primavera Sound festival in Barcelona. The proposed sonic experience begins with "Bajamar," alternating between staggered bursts of distorted guitars and harmonic passages, with the drums providing effective accompaniment in both sections. You can feel the psychedelia; you can sense the raw, rocky texture. While the band cites Pelican, another act in the genre, as an influence, I also detect elements of Mogwai."Pleamar" unfolds in a calm, pleasant manner, albeit in black and white, and the guitar work reminded me of Mike McCready from Pearl Jam. It is on "Medusa" that the quartet truly comes together as a unit, fully utilizing the dual-guitar lineup; one can discern the two distinct paths being traced, sometimes intersecting, other times running parallel. At times, Esteban Jim�nez's guitar stands out, almost seeming to speak or gasp for breath. I also detect influences from the Badmotorfinger era of Soundgarden."�rbita" bridges psychedelia and post-rock like a desert storm, full of lightning and thunder but devoid of rain, a dry storm, where Alberto Tocados's bass plays a pivotal role, providing the counterpoints of tension and calm that link the tempestuous passages together."Jaur�a" is the closest thing to a dramatic climax on the album, a moment of heightened tension where the guitars converge to tell a sometimes somber story, a tale without words or time that, while seeming as though it had always existed, reveals itself as new with every listen.
items._cn_summary: 这是西班牙乐队Toundra的处女作，2007年组建，源自后硬核场景，2008年发行后逐步打入地下音乐圈。整张专辑以器乐为主，吉他作为绝对主导，在失真音墙与干净和声段之间反复切换，鼓点配合严密。Bajamar开场即呈现撕裂式失真与和声段落的交错；Pleamar转向平静柔美的旋律走向；Medusa展现双吉他编制的交错与并行；Órbita将迷幻与后摇滚融合，铺陈出干燥而猛烈的风暴质感；Jauría则是全专辑的戏剧性高潮，吉他在张力顶点汇聚成无声叙事。整体风格在后金属的厚重质感之上融入迷幻与实验色彩，与Pelican、Mogwai、Soundgarden等乐队存在血脉关联，适合喜爱长篇器乐叙事与氛围递进的听众。

items.body: Argentine dark synth duo Balvanera have released the single “Desgaste” with a video and announced their next album, “Hasta tocar el fondo vacío del lenguaje”, for 1 October 2026 on DKA Records in the US and Avant! Records in Europe and the UK. The “Desgaste” video arrived on 2 July 2026. Martín Legón directed the video, a stop-motion collage built from nature footage, glitching machines and old television fragments. “Desgaste” is the first single from the album and the duo’s first new material since their 2021 record. Balvanera sing entirely in Spanish. Balvanera preview a new album with ‘Desgaste’ The album title comes from a fragment of Argentine poet Arturo Carrera’s “Escrito con un nictógrafo” (“Written with a Nyctograph”). “Hasta tocar el fondo vacío del lenguaje” translates as “Until Touching the Empty Bottom of Language”. The record continues Balvanera’s work with DKA Records. The label released their 2021 album “Courses of Action”, their first for DKA, and now handles US distribution for the new album while Avant! Records covers Europe and the UK. “Desgaste” and the album are available to pre-order through the band’s Bandcamp page. About Balvanera Balvanera is a dark synth duo from Buenos Aires, Argentina, made up of Agustina Vizcarra and Lucas Palavecino. The pair issued a self-titled EP in 2016 and released music across minimal synth, wave and EBM over the following years. In 2019 they appeared on the Metropolis Records compilation “Dark Nouveau”, curated by Athan Maroulis, alongside acts such as She Past Away, Twin Tribes and Ash Code. In January 2021 they released the album “Courses of Action” on DKA Records. “Desgaste” opens the campaign for “Hasta tocar el fondo vacío del lenguaje”, which returns the duo to DKA Records and adds Avant! Records for Europe and the UK ahead of the 1 October 2026 release.
items._genre: dark synth / minimal synth / EBM / darkwave
items._cn_summary: 阿根廷布宜诺斯艾利斯的二人组合 Balvanera 即将于 2026 年 10 月 1 日通过 DKA Records（美国）与 Avant! Records（欧洲及英国）发行新专辑《Hasta tocar el fondo vacío del lenguaje》，并以单曲《Desgaste》打头阵。这是继 2021 年专辑《Courses of Action》后乐队的首支新作，跨度约五年。乐队由 Agustina Vizcarra 与 Lucas Palavecino 组成，以西班牙语演唱，风格横跨极简合成器、暗潮与 EBM。此前他们曾出现在 Metropolis Records 2019 年合辑《Dark Nouveau》中，与 She Past Away、Twin Tribes、Ash Code 等同台。《Desgaste》音乐录影带由 Martín Legón 执导，采用定格拼贴手法，将自然影像、故障机器画面与老旧电视碎片拼合而成。专辑标题取自阿根廷诗人 Arturo Carrera 作品《Escrito con un nictógrafo》中的一句，意指触及语言空无之底。

items.album: Runes Order & Regen Graves release dark ambient album ‘Escape’
items.excerpt: Italian dark ambient project Runes Order & Regen Graves have released “Escape“, a new album on the German label Dark Vinyl Records, out 17 July 2026 on CD. The record pairs Claudio Dondo’s long-running Runes Order with Regen Graves, a member of the Genoa horror-doom band Abysmal Grief, and mixes Berlin School electronics with horror and thriller soundtrack elements. items.body: Italian dark ambient project Runes Order & Regen Graves have released “Escape“, a new album on the German label Dark Vinyl Records, out 17 July 2026 on CD. The record pairs Claudio Dondo’s long-running Runes Order with Regen Graves, a member of the Genoa horror-doom band Abysmal Grief, and mixes Berlin School electronics with horror and thriller soundtrack elements. You can stream the album and order the CD through the Bandcamp player below. Escape. by Runes Order & Regen Graves Runes Order & Regen Graves detail ‘Escape’ “Escape” is the second album Claudio Dondo and Regen Graves have made together, following “Falsche Fragen” in 2023. The duo build the record around Berlin School traits – minimalist repetition, long-form soundscapes and analog synth textures – and thread it with horror and thriller cues drawn from Italian film composers Fabio Frizzi and Claudio Simonetti of Goblin, along with John Carpenter. The result stays close to the deep, space-driven ambient that has defined Runes Order across three decades. Argento of the Italian black metal band Spite Extreme Wing returns for the album, adding spoken-word and declamatory vocals; he last appeared with Runes Order on “The Art of Scare and Sorrow” in 2002. Further guests include Laura Agerli of Wuornoss Aileen, Labes C. Necrothytus of Abysmal Grief, saxophonist Alessandro Casoni and Beth P. The album runs to thirteen tracks: “Snow On The House Of Spirits”, “Another Twisted Act”, “Escape From X-Bridge”, “The Sudden Death”, “Bury The Fetus”, “Nuclear Reactor R.B.M.K.”, “La Disintegrazione Delle Ossa”, “Vulnavia”, “Psychedelic Journey Of A Troubled Mind”, “Chi Perde Vincei”, “47-22”, “Reietti Senza Colpa” and “Come Fuoco Sull’Abisso”. Dark Vinyl issues it on CD. About Runes Order & Regen Graves Runes Order is the dark ambient project of Claudio Dondo, based in the Genoa area of Italy. Dondo started the project in 1988 as Order 1968 and renamed it Runes Order in 1992 with the cassette “The Dream Door”. Over the following decades he built a catalogue that includes “La Seduzione Del Silenzio” (1994), “Room 39” (1995), “The Art of Scare and Sorrow” (2002) and “Fase XIV” (2019), working across cassette, CD and vinyl and drawing on the cosmic and Berlin School tradition of Tangerine Dream, Faust and Klaus Schulze. Regen Graves is a musician from the same Genoa scene, known as a member of Abysmal Grief, the Italian horror-doom and gothic band, and active with his own dark ambient and electronic work. Dondo and Regen Graves first joined forces on “Falsche Fragen” in 2023. “Escape” continues that partnership and moves it to Dark Vinyl Records, the German label that also released Runes Order material in the past, extending a project rooted in Italian horror-soundtrack atmospheres and long-form electronic ambient.
items._genre: dark ambient / Berlin School / horror soundtrack

items.body: Review by Fercandio46 — A growth in compositional maturity is evident on the second album by Mimmo Di Martino (guitar), Ettore Vigo (piano and organ), Martin Grice (saxophone and flute), Marcello Reale (bass), and Peppino Di Santo (drums and percussion). Jazz influences persist, albeit with a certain darkness, and the addition of the saxophonist truly adds greater compositional weight. While "Tremori Antichi" is a pleasant ballad, especially when sung in Italian, "Gioia, Disordine, Risentimento" demonstrated a more restless compositional spirit, once again driven by the saxophone.The album then alternates with simpler songs, such as "La Mia Pazzia," which captures that bohemian, communal vibe so popular at the time."Sogno" is another lovely ballad featuring backing vocals, though it moves away from the uptempo acoustic jazz style that suited them so well and where their true strength lay; this becomes apparent when they shine once more during the jazz improvisation in the second half of the track."Dimensione Uomo" is driven by piano and double bass, accompanied by acoustic guitar and backing keyboards, and sung with great feeling by Mimmo Di Martino."Culto Disarmonico" gives free rein to the band's jazz aspirations, with percussion and saxophone once again playing starring roles.Although the album lacks the clear focus of its predecessor, which leaned heavily into the acoustic sound, or its successor, which revisited that style with a more progressive edge, Lo Scemo e Il Villaggio, remains an enjoyable listen, offering that warm, epic, and quintessentially Italian flavor; the album's true gem comes at the end with "Pensiero Per Un Abbandono," featuring the Mellotron, a Renaissance-style piano, and a performance by Mimmo Di Martino that is present in both body and spirit.
items._genre: italian progressive rock / jazz fusion / chamber rock
items._cn_summary: 这是Delirium乐队1972年的第二张专辑，展现出比前作更成熟的作曲功力。五位乐手以吉他、钢琴、管风琴、萨克斯与长笛为核心配置，融合爵士语汇与意大利民谣气质。萨克斯的加入为作品增添了沉郁的重量感，专辑在抒情慢歌与不安分的爵士即兴之间交替推进。钢琴与低音提琴驱动的曲目配合人声演唱，呈现出波西米亚式的群居氛围。终曲是专辑的精华所在，引入Mellotron与文艺复兴风格钢琴，人声演绎情感充沛。整体而言，作品保留了温暖而史诗化的意大利风味，爵士元素贯穿始终，但在实验性与创新性上较为温和，偏向传统的学院派爵士融合路径。

items.body: U.K. alternative noise quartet Death Cult Electric have released their debut double album “Cult Classic”, a 15-track set issued on 26 June 2026 across two volumes through Black Maraca Records, with distribution by Symphonic Distribution. The band, fronted by producer Steffan Pringle, mix hyper-distorted post-punk, alternative rock and industrial-edged noise. Cult Classic (Vol I) by Death Cult Electric Cult Classic (Vol II) by Death Cult Electric Death Cult Electric split ‘Cult Classic’ across two volumes “Cult Classic” runs 15 tracks over two volumes. The first volume holds eight, opening with “Deleter” and moving through “Wishy Washy”, “The FinePrint”, “Lucifer in the Sky with Diamonds”, “In Infrared”, “Ooops! Wrong Planet”, “We are not Bees” and “She Comes too Quick”. The second volume, “Cult Classic (Vol II)”, adds seven: “Alligators”, “Moolah”, “Snakes and their Children”, “I’m So Cool……”, “Let’s Nightmare!”, “A.I Duplicate” and “Burn Bubblegum”. The set pulls together singles the band issued over several years, among them “Deleter”, “The FinePrint”, “She Comes too Quick” and “A.I Duplicate”, alongside newer tracks. Steffan Pringle recorded and mixed the album, mastered to a loudness of 6.66 LUFS. Press material for the release describes it as “It’s like if Nick Cave, Mark E Smith, Andy Falkous, and Guy McKnight became one channeling Big Black and holding Queens of the Stone Age by the throat. […] it rages so hard.” Both volumes are available digitally on Bandcamp and through the band’s Spotify page. About Death Cult Electric Death Cult Electric are a U.K. alternative noise quartet from Cardiff, built around Steffan Pringle, a producer and former member of the Welsh group Estrons who has also produced Adwaith and Himalayas. The current line-up features Pringle alongside Richard Wright, Alec Rees and Christopher Hampson. The group cite Sonic Youth and The Jesus Lizard among their reference points and have shared stages with Pulled Apart By Horses, Mclusky and Midasuno. The project emerged around 2019 with the single “She Comes Too Quick”, followed by “Deleter” and “A.I Duplicate”. In April 2021 the band released the single “The FinePrint” through Black Maraca Records, and later collected early material on the EP “How to Sprint at Strangers”. After a hiatus, Death Cult Electric returned with “Cult Classic”, issued on 26 June 2026 – their first full-length, spreading 15 tracks across two volumes and drawing several of those earlier singles into one release. The band are currently touring.

items.body: Brooklyn synthpop duo Observation Room have announced their debut album, “Superstructure”, set for release on 11 September 2026 through à La Carte Records. The duo of Marina F and Chloe Olson shared the record’s first single, “Running Lights”, in early July 2026, with pre-orders open at Bandcamp. “Superstructure” is the first full-length from Observation Room, following the self-titled EP the pair released in 2025. Marina F produced and mixed the album in Brooklyn, and Sharon Aiza Engel mastered it. Superstructure by Observation Room What Observation Room confirmed about ‘Superstructure’ The album pairs synthpop with drum programming and layered vocals from both members. Its reference points include Depeche Mode, OMD and Book of Love, along with the early Human League and krautrock. Marina F and Chloe Olson tie the lyrics to surveillance, social control and anxiety, connecting private tension to public systems. “Running Lights” is the album’s first single and its opening track, a steady, club-tempo piece led by Marina F’s production. A full tracklist for “Superstructure” has not been confirmed. The record keeps Observation Room on à La Carte Records, the independent collective that has released music by acts Side-Line has covered before, among them Julia Gaeta and Don’t Get Lemon. à La Carte is based in Los Angeles and Washington, DC. About Observation Room Observation Room began as the solo project of Marina F, a Brooklyn-based producer and vocalist who built the earliest demos while traveling between rural Maine and New York City. Chloe Olson later joined on bass, synthesizers and vocals, turning the project into a duo and filling out its live sound. The pair introduced Observation Room with the single “Workers”, then released their self-titled debut EP on à La Carte Records on 11 July 2025. The four-track EP – “The Face of the City”, “Workers”, “Orange Moon Distance” and “Semi-Precious” – was produced and mixed by Marina F in New York City and mastered by Will Killingsworth. à La Carte issued it on two vinyl variants, a blue and red splatter 12-inch limited to 50 copies and a natural 12-inch limited to 100, and the EP streams on Spotify, Apple Music, Bandcamp, Tidal and YouTube Music. The duo’s Bandcamp page also hosts an earlier set of recordings, “Can’t Feel a Thing (Collected Demos)”. With “Superstructure”, Observation Room move from a four-track EP to a full-length while keeping Marina F in the production seat and staying with à La Carte Records for their first album. The record arrives on 11 September 2026, led by “Running Lights”.

items.body:
Will Long dons his dancing slippers for another deep house sojourn on his Long Trax Productions, blowing kisses in the direction of Larry Heard, Ron Trent, DJ Sprinkles.

One decade since minting the ‘Long Trax’ series on Terre Thaemlitz’s label, Comatonse, Will Long slow cooks six new additions on his personal folio, taking all the time needed to get right into the groove. Trust there’s no fireworks or over-produced trickery, just hypnotic deep house that unfurls with a real sense of space, patience and deferred gratification.

Long in his element, following his nose to pair the barest ingredients in classic style and pattern, as with with the likes of ‘About Where It's At (Now You Went N' Did It mix)’, which takes over 4 mins happily swinging away before introducing its lonesome flute motif, or a standout ‘Have to Have Something’ lost in the flow, where the bassline only thickens as it goes along. 

We’re also partial to the square bass budge of ‘Have To Have Something (S' a Lotta Shade mix)’, and the mesmerising meld of creamy bass and piquant cowbell pinging on ‘The Problems’, also found warped with trippier effect on its Metallic Dub reshape.
items._cn_summary: Will Long 在个人厂牌 Long Trax Productions 发布系列第五作，延续十年来对深层浩室的一贯追求。专辑由六首曲目组成，强调极简布局与缓慢铺陈，剥离特效修饰，以最精简的音素构筑律动空间。制作思路致敬 Larry Heard、Ron Trent、DJ Sprinkles 等前辈——低音线层层堆叠后逐步丰满，单簧管动机在四分钟余的摇摆后才悄然浮现，整体注重耐心与延迟满足。代表曲目中，贝斯与牛铃声交织的闷骚质感、以及 dub 化处理的变奏版本，呈现出对经典芝加哥/纽约深层浩室脉络的传承。整体呈现克制而专注的氛围，适合长时间沉浸式聆听。

items.body:
Referencing Van Dyke Parks, Robert Wyatt and Jim O'Rourke, Los Angeles' Aaron MF Olsen goes full chamber pop on his second "songs for singing" album.

Olsen keeps himself busy. In the last few years, he's penned a raft of scores (including one for Matt Hewitt's bizarre b-movie 'Hoagie'), worked alongside Jeff Parker and interpreted Mexican singer-songwriter José Alfredo Jiménez's classing songs on synthesizer. And he's also written two albums of proper songs: 2021's acclaimed 'Songs Album' and this impressive sequel, that's comprised of 10 well sculpted baroque pop moments, each one fleshed out by Olsen's band.

He's not quite as ambitious as Cindy Lee or Panda Bear, but there are moments when Olsen shows a similar command of past, present and future. As the throwbacky 'Nobody Can Tell' fades out, 'There Comes A Time' enters the frame in a brush of looped noise and synth euphoria before settling into its groove, and 'Who Do You Think You Are I Am?' is a minimal throb of staccato percussion and detuned piano hits that rights itself mid-way through when it transforms into a low-slung doo-wop anthem.
items._genre: chamber pop / baroque pop / experimental pop
items._cn_summary: Aaron MF Olsen 的第二张'歌曲专辑'延续了室内流行路线，引用 Van Dyke Parks、Robert Wyatt 和 Jim O'Rourke 的影响作为基调。十首曲目由乐队完整演绎，编排精雕细琢。专辑在复古巴洛克流行的框架中穿插实验片段：循环噪音与合成器带来短暂迷幻时刻，断奏打击乐与失谐钢琴在歌曲中途转入低沉嘟喔风格，展现出对过去、现在与未来音乐语汇的综合驾驭能力。整体定位介于传统歌曲写作与前卫手法之间，相比 Cindy Lee 或 Panda Bear 略显保守，但仍展现出作者在作曲与编排层面的扎实功底。

items.body:
Lushest, hair-kissing deep house and Detroit techno by Kennedy, rolled out effortlessly smooth but kinky and flush with kaotic harmonies on his Dream Machine

Swinging in the breezy wake of chops for Music For Memory and and Pacific Rhythm, ‘Dream 5’ maintains a classic sound on his own label with two sides of the same Motor City-via-Amsterdam currency. A-side ‘Eclipse’ is a conga and pad-led swanger in the mold of Mike Grant’s Moods & Grooves, beautifully suspending hips and limbs in a lip-smcakcing deep house dream sequence, whereas B-side ‘Sky Things’ trades in a sort of deferred gratification, building it up like Derrick May via AGCG/808 State with kinky 727 drum patterns and sky-kissing kaotic harmonies to tease the ‘floor right where you want it.
items._cn_summary: Kennedy 的《Dream 5》在其自营厂牌 Dream Machine 发行双面十二寸，以摩城底特律经阿姆斯特丹中转的电气脉络延续其在前几张作品中确立的经典声响。A 面《Eclipse》以康加鼓与合成垫为核心铺陈，悬挂式的律动让人联想到 Mike Grant 的 Moods & Grooves 厂牌那一脉深邃缓慢的浩室美学。B 面《Sky Things》则转向 Derrick May 风格的延迟满足式构建，727 鼓机节奏与天空般开阔的和声层次在彼此张拉间逐渐逼近舞池临界点。两面作品以充裕的质感与巧妙的结构布局完成了一次对深层浩室与底特律技科的精致回望，整体风格偏向经典延续而非前沿突破，但制作水准与律动把控相当成熟。

items.body:
New from Escho - 'Pusher' OST composer Peter Schneidermann (aka Peter Peter) taps his mates Majke Voss and Ice Age's Elias Rønnenfelt for his proper Bleeder debut, covering Lydia Lunch's 'Boy/Girl' and Fifty Foot Hose's 'If Not This Time' in the process.

Schneidermann is a familiar face on the Copenhagen scene, working closely with Nicolas Winding Refn on the 'Valhalla Rising' score as well as the scores for each of the 'Pusher' films. And he's been a member of the Escho family for years, so it was surely only a matter of time until he collaborated with Rønnenfelt. The band rush for the '90s on 'Marble Station', layering wall-of-sound guitars with deadpan vocals, while on 'Here Comes the Dead', they sound more like Black Country heroes Slade. The band's version of 'Boy/Girl' is stronger, led by rattling hi-hats and sleazy, Suicide-style guitars and they show off their range with their surprisingly tender version of 'If Not This Time'. It's all a bit knowing, sure, but it's Copenhagen, innit.
items._cn_summary: 这是Peter Schneidermann（曾为《Valhalla Rising》及《Pusher》系列电影配乐）在Escho厂牌的首张正式专辑，集合了Majke Voss与Ice Age主唱Elias Rønnenfelt等哥本哈根音乐人共同完成。专辑收录对Lydia Lunch《Boy/Girl》和Fifty Foot Hose《If Not This Time》两首老歌的翻唱。整体风格在九十年代回潮的吉他音墙与Suicide式冷峻简约之间游走，《Marble Station》偏密集噪音摇滚，《Here Comes the Dead》带有Slade式的硬摇滚质感，翻唱作品则展示了更细腻的一面。乐评指出这种带有自觉意识的美学策略是哥本哈根场景的典型特征，音乐本身扎实但并未呈现出明确的实验突破。

items.body: Review by SpookerXG — Oh boy, this is my first review in this page so... i'll make a short introduction about my relationwith this album first.During my first year of University I got into both Metal and Prog, starting with Black Sabbath atone hand, and King Crimson on the other, but sadly I just focused on Ozzy's act rather than theprecious masterpiece of KC's music. When searching for these pals I listened to Starless, that firsthearing was painfull for me since I had no idea about the existence of Prog and the complexity andbeauty of it, only time gave me the chance to fully embrace this genre, I don't regret it at all.Now lets talk about this bad boy, where I actually listened to Prog Rock like it deserved to be, notjust one song on Youtube and and getting tired of the tempo changes and mixture of elements, thistime I was going serious. When I heard Caravan AND Camel (im a Canterbury starter) for the firsttime, I instantly fell in love reaching the end of Mirage; and till today the closing track is oneof my favorite long-songs of all time. The album itself, even in this genre, somestimes feels sounderrated and I can't believe when people says that "Camel is essential" when 50% of the averagelisteners forget about them on rankings of all kind... have you seen the same?About the amazing Camel, it needs no presentation in this page, they are one of the best bands fromthe 70's that common public relates to that cigarette add, and I don't blame them, BUT the musicboys, the freaking sound of their guitars, can someone explain me why Andrew is not even regarded asone of the best guitarists to be born?THE TRACK LIST:* Free Fall: Down, down, down, down, down, OH YEAH! This song is catchy, probably not a verymemorable start, you don't feel the impact of their symphonic sound at first, but the Minimoog givesa unique feeling to it, fan favorite of course but we are far from the creme.* Supertwister: Can't lie about it, I hate when an instrumental is too short but you wan't more ofit, and this is one of those cases, the flute work is incredible and the backing guitar adds somegood company to it, part of my soundtrack for a Saturday's morning.* Nimrodel: Oh Nimrodel... a piece born from the deepest of Camel's creative mind and theirmusicians souls, Andrew's vocals (sometimes too criticized, in my opinion he does a brilliant work!)and again, the amazing guitar, creates an amosphere during the first half of it that no one forgetsin their whole life, then the solo comes in. This could be the masterpiece of the album, but thatspot its deserved for another piece.* Earthrise: Well, this might be the album's weakest point, it certainly isn't a bad song?it's awell-crafted instrumental that builds impressively toward the end?but among the five tracks, this isdefinitely one I tend to forget completely. You can tell the band's sound has matured significantlysince their debut, yet even several tracks from that first album are more interesting than this one.(Still giving it a 5 stars)* Lady Fantasy: Thank you hippies for creating Prog, this awesome trip goes into my Top 10 all timesongs in music history; do you remember when I said that even in Prog the band was nowhere to beseen in rankings and compilations? Just one mention to Mirage and that's all... Well, I think thissuite its the reason because Camel its still one of the best groups that the scene gave to us, withthis epic was that I finally learned to "wait for the gold", those 12 minutes are a no-stop carouselof emotions, and the worst part is when it ends...Im leaving you, at least for now; and don't stop listening to CAMEL, �keep this music alive!

items._cn_summary: 这篇乐评围绕Camel 1974年专辑《Mirage》展开，作者以个人聆听经历为切入，强调这是他严肃聆听前卫摇滚的开端。乐评逐曲讨论了专辑的五首作品：开篇曲Free Fall旋律朗朗上口但记忆点有限，Minimoog为作品增添了独特的音色质感；Supertwister作为短小器乐作品，长笛与吉他配合出色；Nimrodel被作者视为专辑中极具氛围感的佳作，前半段营造出难忘的情绪空间，吉他独奏尤为突出；Earthrise则被认为是专辑最弱的一首，虽编曲工整但容易被遗忘。作者特别指出吉他手Andrew Latimer的演奏技艺被严重低估，质疑其在吉他手排名中长期被忽视的现象。整体而言，这是一篇带有强烈个人情感色彩的前卫摇滚乐评，侧重于传统交响前卫风格内的情感体验与器乐赏析。

items.body: Review by martindavey87 — 'Voice in the Light' is a 2007 concept album by progressive metal supergroup, Amaran's Plight. Featuring renowned musicians such as vocalist D.C. Cooper (Royal Hunt), guitarist Gary Wehrkamp (Shadow Gallery) and drummer Nick D'Virgilio (Spock's Beard), this ambitious release is a treat for fans of the genre, and for fans of the individuals involved. Stylistically, this sounds a lot like Shadow Gallery. Fans of the band will no doubt enjoy this, and it shows the heavy involvement of guitarist and songwriter Gary Wehrkamp. Clocking in at one hour and 19 minutes, and stretching the physical CD to its storage limits, I won't deny that I find the story a bit muddy at times. Whether it's due to the long-winded duration, or just a number of filler tracks causing me to lose interest, usually by the end of the album I'm left baffled by whatever the concept was supposed to be. Musically however, this is a very good release, with a number of particular stand-out moments. The musicianship is excellent (as you'd expect), with plenty of dazzling guitar and keyboard virtuosity, as well as fantastic vocal performances, and the album is full of both heavy and melodic tracks. Highlights include 'Truth and Tragedy', 'Turning Point', 'Betrayed By Love', 'Coming of Age', the beautiful 'Reflections Part 1', and in my opinion the highlight of the album, the energetic 'Viper'. While I doubt this is likely to be anyone's favourite album, especially as the duration can make it a bit of a slog at times, overall, 'Voice in the Light' is a very solid release, and a worthy addition to any progressive metal collection.
items._cn_summary: 这是一张2007年前卫金属超级组合的概念专辑，由D.C. Cooper、Gary Wehrkamp和Nick D'Virgilio等知名乐手合作完成。整体风格与Shadow Gallery极为接近，体现出Wehrkamp在词曲创作和吉他演奏方面的深度参与。专辑时长约79分钟，涵盖了从重型段落到旋律化曲目的丰富层次，吉他与键盘的技术展示突出，人声表现亦相当出色。然而，长篇幅的叙事导致概念脉络在某些段落变得模糊，填充曲目在一定程度上削弱了整体凝聚力。亮点曲目如《Truth and Tragedy》《Turning Point》和《Viper》等展现了乐手的高水准即兴与技术配合，但整体仍属于该流派内的常规制作，缺乏显著的实验性突破或跨界融合元素。

items.body: Devoratus, a darkwave band from Denver, Colorado, released the “Vacio” EP on 4 July 2026. The three-track record is sung in Spanish and English and is available to stream on Spotify. The title translates from Spanish as “empty” or “void.” The EP’s three tracks are “Abismo oscuro,” “Dance” and “For You.” The songs move between Spanish titles and lyrics and English refrains, the bilingual approach the band has used since its first releases in 2023. Across the three tracks the band addresses isolation, desire, mortality and change. Inside the Devoratus ‘Vacio’ EP Devoratus records as a trio of Tomas on vocals, Aero on synths and Renee on bass, with Cisco adding live guitar. On “Vacio” the arrangements pair cold synth lines and heavy low end with guitar and forward-driving drums. The band released the EP without a label credit, as a digital release; no physical edition has been announced. Musically the band can be compared to darkwave acts including Lebanon Hanover and She Past Away. About Devoratus Devoratus is a darkwave and post-punk band from Denver, Colorado. The band describes itself as a “Post Punk Darkwave Latino Band” and sings in both Spanish and English. Its recording lineup is Tomas on vocals, Aero on synths and Renee on bass, with Cisco on live guitar. The band began releasing music in 2023, starting with the single and video “Distancia” and the “Amissus” EP the same year. In February 2024 Devoratus issued the single “Flotando,” followed later in 2024 by the three-track “Vida Irreal” EP, made up of “Cold Night,” “Mal” and “Vampira.” Those earlier releases remain on the band’s Bandcamp page. With the “Vacio” EP on 4 July 2026, Devoratus continues the Spanish-and-English darkwave it has released since 2023.
items._cn_summary: 来自科罗拉多州丹佛的暗潮乐队Devoratus于2026年7月发行三曲EP《Vacio》，标题在西班牙语中意为'空'或'虚空'。乐队以三人核心阵容运作：Tomas担任主唱、Aero负责合成器、Renee演奏贝斯，Cisco作为现场吉他手加入。整张EP在西班牙语与英语之间切换，延续了自2023年首张单曲《Distancia》和EP《Amissus》以来的双语路线，主题围绕孤立、欲望、死亡与变迁。编曲以冷调合成器线条与厚重的低频为骨架，叠加吉他与推进式鼓击，音乐参考系指向Lebanon Hanover与She Past Away等暗潮代表乐队。该EP以独立数字发行，未签任何厂牌，亦无实体版本计划。作为一张模式较为清晰的暗潮/后朋克作品，其双语文化视角和拉丁裔身份为传统欧式暗潮注入了一定新意，但整体仍处于该类型的安全范围之内，尚未展现出显著的实验突破。

items.body: Dead Voices on Air, the project of Mark Spybey, will release a new album, “Mothcomma”, worldwide through Re:Mission Entertainment on 17 July 2026. The 12-track album comes out on CD and in digital form, with pre-orders open at Bandcamp and the project’s Big Cartel store. Dead Voices on Air recorded “Mothcomma” in the aftermath of the project’s 2025 US tour, with sessions split between the Tees Valley in North East England and Lafayette, Colorado. The album was made on both sides of the Atlantic, and mixes the project’s experimental, industrial and dark ambient elements, moving between song structures, ambient passages, hand-built rhythms and treated vocals. Named tracks include “Pas de Chasse”, the title track “Mothcomma” and “For the Rush of Black Tar”. Mothcomma by Dead Voices on Air Recording and credits behind Dead Voices on Air ‘Mothcomma’ The album credits Nathan Jamiel, Mark Spybey and Stephen Weatherall, with additional contributions from Robert Galbraith and Elizabeth Virosa of Snowbeasts and from Lori Cole. Robert Galbraith mastered the record. Nathan Jamiel, of the Denver band The Drood, and Stephen Weatherall have contributed to the project’s last two albums and played Spybey’s autumn 2025 US concerts. Pre-orders run through Bandcamp and the Big Cartel store, where the “Mothcomma” CD is listed alongside a new run of t-shirts. Stock is limited: some items ship from the United States and others directly from Spybey in the UK, and the first 40 orders include a Dead Voices on Air logo sticker. About Dead Voices on Air Dead Voices on Air formed in Vancouver in 1992, when Mark Spybey, who had played in Newcastle’s Zoviet France in the late 1980s, began the project with Scott Harker and Clancy Dennehey. It became the ongoing vehicle for Spybey’s experimental, industrial and dark ambient work. Spybey was also an original member of Download, the offshoot featuring Skinny Puppy’s cEvin Key, and recorded under the name Propeller. Across more than three decades, Spybey has collaborated widely, working with Graham Lewis of Wire, Faust, Michael Rother of Neu!, Dieter Moebius of Cluster, Jarboe of Swans, Jochen Arbeit of Einstürzende Neubauten, Lee Scratch Perry, Pigface and Snowbeasts. He has released through labels including Cold Spring, Soleilmoon, Kranky, Nettwerk, Emergency Hearts and Re:Mission Entertainment, and works with Zoviet France co-founder Robin Storey as Reformed Faction. In 2022 Emergency Hearts published Spybey’s musical memoir “Explicit in Purpose”. Side-Line has followed the project in recent years, from the 2022 re-release of its debut as “Abrader Redux” to the 2023 collaborative album “Pennine” with Xqui, and spoke with Spybey for a 2021 ‘Click Interview’. In spring 2023 Spybey formed DADU with friends from his home town; Nathan Jamiel and Stephen Weatherall, who feature on “Mothcomma”, came out of that circle and toured the US with him in 2025. “Mothcomma” is the project’s newest release for Re:Mission Entertainment.
items._cn_summary: 本文为Dead Voices on Air新专辑「Mothcomma」的发行新闻，介绍该作由Mark Spybey主导，录制于英国东北部Tees Valley与美国科罗拉多州Lafayette两地，融合实验、工业与暗潮氛围元素，在歌曲结构、环境段落、手工节奏与处理过人声之间穿梭。合作阵容包括Nathan Jamiel、Stephen Weatherall，以及Snowbeasts成员Robert Galbraith与Elizabeth Virosa等。文章同时回顾了Spybey的履历脉络，从Zoviet France到Download再到Reformed Faction，展现其横跨三十余年的跨领域协作网络与稳定的地下厂牌发行路径。作为专辑预告性质的资讯文本，对音乐本体缺乏深入分析与评论，仅提供曲目、阵容与发行渠道等基础信息。

items.body:
Following her acclaimed 2022 album 'Weather Alive', Beth Orton returns with another fully self-produced collection of songs, this time bringing in help from Shahzad Ismaily, Vernon Spring's Sam Beste, drummers Chris Vatalaro and Vishal Nayak, trumpet player Christos Styliandes and bassist Tom Herbert.

Orton sounded refreshed on 'Weather Alive'. Taking the production into her own hands for the first time, she crafted a personal world that was completely her own, weaving in old recordings of her parents and recording a busted piano she snapped up at Camden Market. The music felt like a form of catharsis, dreamily reflecting on years of boozing and raving, when she made her mark as a guest vocalist for artists like the Chemical Brothers and William Orbit. That mature, knowing air - the kind of mettle you build up only after real-world experience - hangs around 'The Ground Above', giving Orton's tender, heartfelt songs genuine power and proper weight. When she sings "I'm as invincible as grief, dancing cross a lake of loss," on the epic opener 'The Ground Above', you don't doubt her for a moment.

Orton's voice has always been distinct, a soulful rasp that's fragile one moment and sturdy the next, and it sounds as if she's finally found the right music to match it. On that eight-minute opener, it's quick syncopated drums that lodge themselves somewhere between Roni Size's 'New Forms' and Radiohead's 'Hail to the Thief', reversed, psychedelic guitar riffs, jazzy horn blasts and pillowy ambient textures. 'Cigarette Curls', meanwhile, slows things down, pairing her voice with smudged piano phrases and smoke-y rhythms. She breezes past the shape of classic soul pop on 'Waiting', even taking on a half-sung chorus, but sounds most comfortable when she strips down the instrumentation even further, crooning over brushed percussion and euphoric pads on the gorgeous 'I'll Miss You'.
items._cn_summary: Beth Orton 延续上一张专辑完全自主制作的路线，邀请 Shahzad Ismaily 等多位乐手参与录音，呈现出内省而成熟的艺术表达。她将父母的老录音融入创作，并使用卡姆登市场淘来的破损钢琴采样，构建出带有宣泄感的私人音乐世界。八分钟的同名开场曲融合碎拍鼓点、迷幻吉他与爵士号角，介于 Roni Size 与 Radiohead 之间；其他曲目则从钢琴民谣缓降到更精简的刷擦打击乐配器，情感表达克制而有分量。作为融合电子元素与民谣唱作传统的英国艺人，她的嗓音兼具灵魂乐的粗粝沙哑与脆弱感，在自我剖析的歌词中寻找力量。

items.body:
Featuring MØ, Quiet Light, Koilwood, Helena Gao and others, Copenhagen duo A Good Year's second album is another slick set of trip-hop inspired Danish pop from the reliable Escho stable, home of Smerz, Astrid Sonne, Iceage and Snuggle.

Albert Hildebrand and Tobias Laust Hansen didn't have a fixed idea in mind when they started work on 'Play'. As the title suggests, it emerged from just playing, improvising with each other and shuttling recordings back and forth between their collaborators. "The music became a vessel for connection," they explain. "A way to reach to people we admire, but also a way to create a social element within these sometimes introverted jams." And their approach leads to an uncommonly light set of almost-pop; it's still as neatly polished as anything from the fertile Copenhagen scene, but there's a willing naivety that allows breathing room, a way for errors to slip in and humanize the material in the face of AI perfection.

Fine collaborator Koilwood shows up on the charming 'Back of a car', whispering softly over Hildebrand and Hansen's skipping lo-fi beats and skeletal instrumentation and Tiffi Malmgren lends her voice to early highlight 'Flight', a slo-mo trip-hop dream that's lifted by the duo's tape-warped piano vamps and hazy textures. And Malmgren returns with Major Lazer collaborator MØ (yep it was her on 'Lean On') on the album's stand-out 'Blue Flame', an electrified indie anthem that makes good use of the Danish singers' unique, recognizable voices. Scandi pop lovers, this'll hit the spot.
items._cn_summary: 哥本哈根二人组A Good Year的第二张专辑《Play》延续了北欧流行的精致质感，但更偏向trip-hop启发下的轻快流行路线。两位音乐人没有预设方向，而是通过远程互发录音片段、即兴合作的方式完成创作，邀请MØ、Koilwood、Helena Gao等多位歌手参与。专辑中慢速trip-hop作品《Flight》以磁带失真钢琴和朦胧音色营造梦境感，Koilwood客串的《Back of a car》以极简lo-fi节拍为骨架，而收录MØ的《Blue Flame》被乐评视为专辑亮点，将两位丹麦女声的辨识度融进电气化独立流行框架。整张作品保留了该厂牌一贯的抛光感，却刻意保留了部分瑕疵与天真气息，作为Scandi流行向作品具备一定可听性。

items.body:
100% killer reissue of Bim Sherman’s self-released 1988 dub masterpiece ‘Ghetto Dub’, mixed by King Tubby, Prince Jammy and Adrian Sherwood who diffuse rhythms by The Roots Radics and Sly & Robbie, newly remastered for its first new edition in 30 years.

With 2nd hand prices understandably climbing into triple figures, this overdue first vinyl reissue will be mana to the fiends. It takes pride of place in an ongoing programme of resurrected Sherman aces to portray him at his most elusive and atmospheric, or as the hype sticker calls it, “a journey in echo and space”.

His legendarily tone is threaded thru the desk by a team of JA/UK titans with the man himself in the producer role, sifting cuts from his Century Records: a label set up in the Uk in 1984, after his move from Kingston, JA, to London, where he became a crucial figure in the On-U Sound crew after joining their 1979 tour, and would lend to classic Dub Syndicate cuts among others. 

The record’s renown has grown over the years since Sherman’s passing in 2000 and the effective dissolution of his label. Week-End Records now do a sterling job of preserving his legacy with this edition, richly representing the warmth and pressure of the OG in its entirety, from the clean-spurred, buoyant step of its title tune to moon-booted ‘Untitled Dub’, via the soul-tugging ace ’Station Dub’ with its unanswered doorbells, and best showcase of his voice in ‘Moving Dub’, another alright stepper in ‘World Dub’, the bloozy wooze of ‘Danger Dub’ and wickedly skewed Afro-lilt of ‘Tribulation Dub.’

All killer.
items._cn_summary: 本文介绍Bim Sherman 1988年同名Dub专辑的再版发行。专辑混合工作由King Tubby、Prince Jammy与Adrian Sherwood三位制作人共同完成，伴奏由The Roots Radics与Sly & Robbie提供。整套制作以回声、空间感和节奏的拆解为核心，强调dub特有的声学处理手法，呈现出空灵而深沉的氛围。曲目既有轻快灵动的标题曲，也有步态沉重的dub段落，辅以绵延的键盘与人声片段。世足叔于2000年逝世后，其创立的厂牌也随之解散，这次再版由Week-End Records完成，重新呈现了原版温暖厚重的质感，为保存其音乐遗产做出贡献。全文本质上以新闻式推介为主，乐评深度有限。

items.body:
Copenhagen group Liss' 2022 album, 'I Guess Nothing Will Be The Same' on Escho. 

"Danish four piece Liss' debut album in the hopes of creating a lasting legacy for late lead singer Søren Holm''s life, love and talent. Although recording began many years prior, the album was only finished shortly before Holm tragically passed away in May 2021. From the most recent release "Boys In Movies ft. Nilüfer Yanya", which oscillates gorgeously between dark, grungy guitar chords and a sunny, optimistic ear worm of a chorus, to "Exist", an ethereal plea with hints of a hymn in the vocal stacks, the record shows all the transfixing sides of Liss with extraordinary heart."
items._cn_summary: 这是丹麦哥本哈根四人乐队Liss的首张专辑，由独立厂牌Escho发行。主唱Søren Holm在2021年5月不幸离世，专辑在其生前完成录制并发行。乐评提及单曲《Boys In Movies》与Nilüfer Yanya合作，呈现暗色grungy吉他与明亮副歌之间的对比；《Exist》则在人声堆叠中展现出空灵、近似圣咏的氛围。整体风格以独立摇滚为底色，融合梦幻流行的旋律感与吉他质感，带有一定的情绪深度与忧郁气质，但并未涉及实验、前卫、电子合成或爵士即兴等用户偏好的方向。乐评原文较为简短，以介绍性描述为主，缺乏深层音乐分析。

items.body: Review by kev rowland — It has been quite a while since I last heard from French band Siiilk, but I was a huge fan of their 2017 album 'Endless Mysteries' and this four-track set was recorded just two years later at Les Nuits de Fourvi�re on July 21st, 2019, when they were the opening act for Nick Mason's Saucerful of Secrets. Given they were the opening act I presume this is the complete set, so we have four songs, with three from the 2012 debut and only one from the previous album. The line-up has been stable with Richard Pick (lead vocals, acoustic guitar), Catherine Pick (vocals, Indian harmonium), Gilbert Gandil (electric guitar), Jacques Roman (keyboards) and Guillaume Antoncelli (bass guitar) still there and the only change being the introduction of a new drummer, Cl�ment Vullion.In some ways this material is quite reminiscent of Hackett, but there are undoubtedly also elements of Pink Floyd, Seventies Barclay James Harvest, Camel, Caravan, and so much more. There are times when it is almost folk in its approach, at others it is pastoral while it can be somewhat driving at others. Richard's vocals do have an accent, and in many ways that is the only way to determine this is not a British act as it certainly has far more influences from across the channel than it does from France. Catherine's vocals are wonderfully clear and light, providing a contrasting dynamic to Richard while her harmonium also takes their music in a different direction and the nuanced addition of birdsong certainly feels right within the context.I missed out on their last studio album, 2022's 'Eemynor" but it was recorded by the same line-up as this, so I have high hopes and definitely need to seek it out. If you have yet to come across Siiilk then this is a great introduction and at only 5 euro is a real bargain. If you like the more thoughtful and less bombastic or experimental styles of prog then this is something you need to explore.
items._genre: crossover prog / pastoral folk prog / symphonic prog
items._cn_summary: 这张现场专辑收录了法国乐队SIIILK于2019年在里昂富维耶之夜音乐节为Nick Mason的Saucerful of Secrets暖场时的四首曲目，其中三首来自2012年的首张专辑，仅一首出自2017年备受好评的《Endless Mysteries》。乐队的音乐风格被比作Steve Hackett、平克·弗洛伊德、七十年代的Barclay James Harvest、Camel和Caravan，兼具民谣的质朴与田园诗般的宁静，时而又有强劲的推进力。主唱Richard Pick的嗓音带有法式口音，而Catherine Pick清澈轻盈的声线与印度手风琴的运用形成了鲜明对比，鸟鸣采样等细节增添了自然氛围。整体而言，这是一张偏传统的前摇滚作品，强调旋律与氛围营造，乐队阵容稳定，仅鼓手有所更换。录音质量扎实，作为入门了解这支法国乐队的起点相当合适，价格也颇为亲民。

items.body: Review by Heart of the Matter — The watchmaker steadies his delicate hand... uh, sorry, I wasn't really quoting Mr Gabriel, just thinking of that figure of an artisan with spectacles and ageing but steady hands that Steve Howe has become over so many years. And, as well as it seems perfectly true that the image and the job fit him like no other, one still has the right to ask if that is sufficient to sustain the continuation of a band's career after, again, so many years. And it may well be so, since his convoluted brilliancy shines all over this album, with lines of lush slide guitar lace, and breathtaking precision in the irregular rhythms. The best of his contribution is, of course, in the longest track, Countermovement, which reminds strongly of Double Rondo, that marvellous piece of symphonic fantasy included in his second solo effort from 1979. And that is fine with me, but don't think for a second that that is all, and the band have no proper role here. On the contrary, the rhythm section sounds muscular and precise (if not spontaneous) at the same time, the keyboards supply enough classically inspired structure as to save dignity, the orchestra do their part with an elegance excluding any excess, and the singer, finally, seems to be starting to grasp that is no duty of his to stay in the upper region of his strained vocal chords all the time, and begins to complement his efforts with Steve and the others. Not everything here is gold, but there's gold enough in the end, like those stars sprinkling in the cover.
items._genre: symphonic prog / progressive rock / art rock
items._cn_summary: 专辑以管弦乐化的前卫摇滚为框架，史蒂夫·豪的吉他线条贯穿始终，滑棒吉他纹理与不规则节奏构成核心肌理。键盘提供古典化的结构支撑，弦乐编排克制而优雅，节奏组表现精准但缺乏自发性。最长曲目《Countermovement》回溯其1979年独奏作品中《Double Rondo》的交响幻想气质。歌手开始尝试在音域中下游配合乐队，而非始终维持高位的嘶喊，整体呈现出老牌乐手稳定输出但探索边际有限的面貌。

items.body: Review by Progfan97402 — I was wondering if this would ever be accepted into Prog Archives, there's no doubt the music was worthy of inclusion and I'm glad it's now in the database. It's hard for me to think of another prog rock album that is more obscure than this. Apparently, the album did get manufactured by EMI/Electrola (but it had a generic blue label to look more like a private press) so it likely made it into standard record stores in West Germany at the time. The cover to Pacific Prison screams American private press prog album, except this isn't American at all. This does not have that professional polish, so if that's what you're wanting you won't find it here. The vocals definitely do not have that polish, either. What you get is symphonic prog with space rock overtones. Lots of Hammond organ, Elka Rhapsody, and the ARP 2600 synthesizer. It sounds like what would happen if you cross Eloy with Pulsar, and perhaps a bit of Novalis but without the polished production and a more underground feel, this is what you get. There is also some flute as well (more like Pulsar than Jethro Tull). If there is a concept behind this album it's hard telling, but all the songs segue together for one continuous listen, aside from switching from side one to side two if you own the LP. While the the shortcomings are a bit obvious, it doesn't have a great production and it definitely a bit rough around the edges, it's still a nice album worth hearing especially if you don't mind a more underground take on the German symphonic prog/space rock sound.
items._cn_summary: 这张1978年专辑由德国音乐人在EMI/Electrola旗下以仿私制形式发行，融合了交响前卫与太空摇滚的特质。编曲以Hammond风琴、Elka Rhapsody和弦乐为基础，辅以ARP 2600合成器与长笛段落，歌曲之间采用无缝衔接方式连缀为整体聆听体验。评论将其定位为Eloy与Pulsar、Novalis之间的地下化变体，缺少精致打磨但保留了原始质感。制作略显粗糙，整体仍属传统七十年代德语交响前卫范畴，在声音设计和实验性层面并未有显著突破，与当代实验、电子或暗潮等领域的交集有限。

items.body: Spanish electro-industrial act Larva have announced UK and Spanish live dates for autumn 2026, and the Larva tour dates pair a four-show UK run supporting Massive Ego with two hometown appearances in Barcelona. The Barcelona-based band confirmed the schedule through their official channels, with the UK leg running from 3 to 6 September and the Spanish dates set for late September and Halloween. The UK shows place Larva on Massive Ego’s first headline UK tour, the “Symphony Of Flies Tour”, which the British darkwave act built around their 2026 album for Out Of Line Music. After four dates alongside Massive Ego, the duo return home for Barnadark Fest III and a DJ set at Barcelona’s Nocturna Festival. Larva tour dates for autumn 2026 3 September 2026 – Nottingham, UK – The Old Cold Store (with Massive Ego) 4 September 2026 – Glasgow, UK – Ivory Blacks (with Massive Ego) 5 September 2026 – Sheffield, UK – Corporation (with Massive Ego) 6 September 2026 – London, UK – The Lexington (with Massive Ego) 26 September 2026 – Barcelona, Spain – Barnadark Fest III 31 October 2026 – Barcelona, Spain – Nocturna Festival (DJ set) The four UK dates are support slots on the Massive Ego tour, which also carries Dead Lights and The Silent Era. Tickets for the UK shows are on sale through the venues. The Nocturna Festival appearance on 31 October is a DJ set rather than a live show; the Barcelona edition takes place at Sala Upload. About Larva Larva is a dark electro and electro-industrial project from Barcelona. InqUesT founded it in 1998 under the name Morbid Mind and reshaped it as Larva in 2003. Most of the catalogue has appeared through the Hungarian label Advoxya Records, and the project has worked the European dark-electro circuit for more than two decades, performing as a duo. Side-Line covered the band’s eleventh studio album, “Void”, on its 2021 release through Advoxya, and spoke with the band for a ‘Click Interview’ in 2020. Larva followed “Void” with “The Rat King” in 2023 and the 14-track “Prescindibles”, issued on CD by Advoxya on 21 January 2025. The autumn 2026 dates take Larva back to the UK alongside Massive Ego and close the year with two Barcelona appearances.
items._cn_summary: 本文并非乐评，而是西班牙巴塞罗那电子工业二人组 Larva 宣布 2026 年秋季巡演日期的新闻稿。文章详细列出了英国四场支持 Massive Ego「Symphony Of Flies Tour」的演出场地与日期，以及在巴塞罗那 Barnadark Fest III 与 Nocturna Festival 的两场家乡演出。文章简要回顾了 Larva 的历史：1998 年由 InqUesT 以 Morbid Mind 之名创立，2003 年更名为 Larva，作品主要由匈牙利厂牌 Advoxya Records 发行，过去曾推出《Void》《The Rat King》等专辑及 2025 年新作《Prescindibles》。作为一篇纯巡演新闻公告，内容不具备音乐评论深度，缺乏对声音设计、艺术理念或作品创新的探讨。

items.body:
Since everyone else has written something about the centennials of Miles Davis and John Coltrane, why not join the parade? It is a good opportunity to look at the timeline of bassists the legendary trumpeter and saxophonist used. Born just under four months apart, the pair worked together under the elder Davis’ name periodically between Fall 1955 and Spring 1957 before a more steady affiliation in 1958-1960.

It is in that latter period that this analysis will begin, as it gives a convenient bit of serendipity: the fact that two of the their most famed albums were made in that period, Davis’ Kind Blue (March 2nd and April 22nd, 1959 for Columbia) and Coltrane’s Giant Steps (May 4th–5th and December 2nd, 1959). And the analysis will end with Coltrane’s death in 1967, which came during the tenure of Davis’ “second great quintet” and before his groups swelled and electrified during his fusion period.

As such, we begin with the same man, the bassist on both those albums: Paul Chambers. He had taken up the bass a decade earlier in his adopted home of Detroit (where he was a student at the seminal Cass Technical High School ... more on that later). He arrived in New York in 1954 at 19. By the time of Kind of Blue and Giant Steps, he had been on over 100 sessions from dozens of leaders, with multiple dates under Davis (with whom he had started working in late 1955) and Coltrane (who had used him for several albums in 1957-58 as well as both fellow sideman for many others and Chambers also hiring Coltrane for his own sessions). In addition to the five albums he led, Chambers played on sessions for Benny Golson, Curtis Fuller, J.J. Johnson, Lee Morgan, Red Garland, Sonny Clark, and Sonny Rollins.

The collaboration between Davis and Chambers was remarkably fruitful before and after Kind of Blue and solidified a part of Davis’ music that had previously seen widely differing players like Tommy Potter, Oscar Pettiford, Al McKibbon, and Percy Heath. The rest of 1959 saw multiple engagements around the country and closed with recordings that would be part of another monumental record, Sketches of Spain, that paired Davis’ group with the Gil Evans Orchestra. 1960 continued that momentum with more Sketches of Spain recording and almost non-stop touring, including two stretches in Europe, from Spring onward. 1961 and 1962 had more of the same activity, the documents being Someday My Prince Will Come and Quiet Nights. Then, quite suddenly, Chambers left Davis’ group in early February 1963.

It should be stated that Chambers did not restrict his activities solely to Davis, recording over four dozen albums during the period with, among many others, Jackie McLean, Wynton Kelly, Benny Golson, Hank Mobley, and Curtis Fuller. And after leaving Davis, he worked steadily with an array of leaders through the end of 1968, sadly passing away from tuberculosis caused and/or aggravated by drug abuse at only 33.

Stepping right into the Davis group was another Cass Technical High School alumnus: Ron Carter. Nearly 26, Carter was already prophesying his prolific career, participating in over three dozen albums since 1960, with the likes of Charli Persip, Yusef Lateef, Eric Dolphy, Don Ellis, Coleman Hawkins, Cecil Payne, Jaki Byard, Wes Montgomery, Bobby Timmons, Tadd Dameron, Dizzy Reece, Ken McIntyre, Milt Jackson, Benny Golson and others, plus waxing his leader debut, Where?, for Prestige subsidiary New Jazz in 1961.

It was Carter’s arrival that heralded Davis’ soon-to-be seminal band, though it took until Fall 1964 for its personnel to solidify. With Carter, Davis recorded Seven Steps To Heaven and played the Antibes festival in 1963. What is interesting though is while the “second great quintet” is thought of as a monolith, the bass chair had some upheaval/fluidity, depending on how you look at it. Gary Peacock – already a veteran and likely the only person to work for both Bud Shank and Albert Ayler – took the chair for nearly six weeks in the spring of 1964, Carter returning thereafter through the end of the year. 1965 began auspiciously with the January recording of E.S.P. but then things derailed with a convalescing Davis unable to play. And when he could, in November and December, Carter, a hot commodity, was absent, spelled by Peacock once more, then Reggie Workman, who had come up around the same time as Carter and had already come and gone in the groups of Coltrane. In 1966, Carter would return to the group but only partially, participating in East Coast performances, shows elsewhere having either Richard Davis, Carter’s only real equal in terms of fecundity, or in the Peacock mold of eclecticism, Eddie Gomez, returning permanently in October, just before the album Miles Smiles. 1967 was similar: Carter was on board when not busy elsewhere, Gomez on call, then Albert Stinson for one show (a little over two years before his passing – see Bass Tragedies column in Issue 94) and then another veteran, Buster Williams, for a tour (and playing on one track of the 1981-released compilation album Directions). Carter would fill a fixed point for all of 1967, including the albums Sorcerer and Nefertiti and would continue with Davis through the middle of 1968.

Like Chambers or perhaps even more so, Carter was also on the greater jazz scene during his tenure with Davis. He recorded on sessions led by his fellow Davis bandmates but also by everyone from Bobby Timmons, Charles Lloyd, Donald Byrd and Bobby Hutcherson to Jimmy Smith, Shirley Scott, Eddie Harris, and Stanley Turrentine, to name only a handful. He has, of course, gone on to be likely the most recorded bassist in jazz history.

Paul Chambers’ time under Coltrane was shorter and more intermittent. After Giant Steps he was part of, along with the rest of Davis’ period band, November 1959 recordings that would partly comprise Coltrane Jazz and be brought back 18 months later as one of three individual bassists taking part in the Africa/Brass recordings (though his contribution was only heard on the 1995 complete sessions version).

Also in 1959 was a Birdland engagement for Coltrane where either Ahmed Abdul-Malik or George Tucker, both established and close in age to Coltrane, were on bass.

In 1960 Coltrane hired the slightly younger Steve Davis in what seems to be his first professional engagement. Davis stayed in the band through the end of the year for all its live dates and played on music recorded in October and released piecemeal on My Favorite Things, Coltrane Jazz, Coltrane Plays the Blues, and Coltrane’s Sound. Though Davis lived until 1987, his credits after Coltrane were slight: the Mangione Brothers, Dave Burns, McCoy Tyner, Kenny Dorham, James Moody, Freddie McCoy, and Eddie Jefferson, all made in the ‘60s. One deviation in the year came via Coltrane’s shared date with Don Cherry, The Avant-Garde, where bass was handled by either Charlie Haden or Percy Heath.

1961 was a year in flux, bassist-wise, for Coltrane. He introduced a concept to which he would return later in the decade by using two bassists for an engagement at Chicago’s Sutherland Lounge in March: Raphael Don Garrett and Workman, the former, about six years younger, working with Roland Kirk, Paul Serrano, and Eddie Harris, the latter 11 years younger, sideman for Gigi Gryce, Donald Byrd, Duke Jordan, Richard Williams, and Dave Pike.

Workman would be part of the aforementioned Africa/Brass, as would, separately, another bassist, Art Davis, already with credits under Max Roach, Lee Morgan, Booker Little, Hal Mooney, Ernestine Anderson, Dizzy Gillespie, Leo Wright, Clifford Jordan/Sonny Red, Abbey Lincoln, and Booker Little. But in May they were together for Ole Coltrane and nearly a month at the Village Vanguard in August. Workman would become the fixed bassist for Coltrane through the end of the year for concerts, including a European tour, and a small portion of the Ballads album from the end of the year. An exception was Workman either alternating or alongside Jimmy Garrison for a November stint at the Village Vanguard.

If not for a family health crisis forcing Workman to leave the group at the end of 1961 and return to his native Philadelphia, he likely would have stayed with the band and jazz history been quite different. It should be said that Workman hardly is a footnote, becoming one of the most revered players of his generation. But it was Garrison who became the anchor. Born between Garrett and Workman, prior to joining Coltrane he had worked with Philly Joe Jones, Curtis Fuller, Kenny Dorham, Jackie McLean, JR Montrose, Walter Bishop, Jr., Ornette Coleman, Bill Barron, and Ted Curson.

Unlike Carter and Davis, once Garrison was on board, he stayed there. That was mostly to do with Coltrane’s packed schedule of touring and albums and that, unlike Davis, he was healthy and non-combustible. From 1962-1964, Garrison was omnipresent, including the bulk of Ballads, Duke Ellington & John Coltrane (where he split duties with Ellington’s period bassist Aaron Bell), 2018 discovery Both Directions At Once, John Coltrane And Johnny Hartman, Impressions, Crescent, another new millennium unearthed gem in Blue World, and closing out the year with Coltrane’s magnum opus A Love Supreme (which added Art Davis for a second day of recording, released as a second disc to the album’s deluxe edition in 2002).

In 1965 Garrison was still the main man but occasionally Davis would be alongside him: partially on The John Coltrane Quartet Plays in February and fully for June’s Ascension. Otherwise, Garrison was the sole bassist for performances and most of the other albums: Transition, Sun Ship, and Meditations. The exceptions without Davis were overdubs of Haden for the posthumously released Infinity and Garrett returning to play both bass and clarinet for Live In Seattle (as well as the 2021 archival release A Love Supreme: Live In Seattle), Om, and part of Kulu Se Mama.

1966 was even more Garrison-centric, with the only documented work including a second bassist shows in November and December with Lionel “Sonny” Johnson, the brother of Dewey Johnson, who had played on Ascension. The last year of Coltrane’s life, Garrison was there as well, with one notable absence: the Coltrane/Rashied Ali duet Interstellar Space.

Unlike Chambers or Carter, Garrison was kept so busy during his time with Coltrane that his outside discography at the time is meager, though it does include his sole leader date, Illumination! with the Elvin Jones/Jimmy Garrison Sextet. Otherwise it was sessions with Lorez Alexandria, Coltrane bandmate McCoy Tyner, Sonny Rollins, Bill Dixon, and Robert F. Pozar.

After Coltrane’s death, Garrison kept working but his documentation slowed, his two Blue Note dates with the Jones trio rounded out by Joe Farrell being the most enduring. There were also dates with Rolf and Joachim Kuhn, Clifford Thornton and Nathan Davis, and regular work with Alice Coltrane and Archie Shepp. His final recording came in early 1975 with Beaver Harris and Dave Burrell’s 360 Degree Music Experience. Garrison died of lung cancer in 1976 at 42.

items.body: Review by Fercandio46 — Vocalist Marco Cecioni brought experience from his earlier stint with the 1960s band Battitori Selvaggi to the formation of Il Balletto di Bronzo; their album Sirio 2222 is a compendium of influences carried over from that decade, such as psychedelia and the sound of Jimi Hendrix, delivered by a razor-sharp quartet that sounded both tight and energetic.The album kicks off with the rock-oriented "Un Posto" and the bluesy "Eh Eh Ah Ah"; while "Neve Calda" may not offer many compositional complexities, it captures that epic 1960s style, alongside drummer Giancarlo Stinga's Mitch Mitchell-esque playing. Influences of Eric Burdon & The Animals can also be traced."Ma Ti Aspetter�" borders on hard rock, reminiscent of early Black Sabbath, though the bass playing displays a distinctly jazzy fluidity."Meditazione" is something different; it features string arrangements by Giacomo Simonelli, and Marco Cecioni delivers a spot-on vocal performance, even if the composition itself isn't particularly remarkable. However, the track truly takes flight when the clavichord enters, raising the bar in a way that foreshadows the definitive album that would follow this one.Girotondo's psychedelic jams infused with pop melodies flowed naturally and made for enjoyable listening, yet the quartet could also turn wild, as seen in "Incantesimo," where those same improvisations took on a heavy blues feel, much like in "Ti Risveglierai Con Me." (It was used as the soundtrack for the Italian crime film Five Dolls for an August Moon, a prime example of giallo cinema directed by Mario Bava, that same year.)"Missione Sirio 2222" is the album's most ambitious composition, alongside "Meditazione", steeped in a floating psychedelia that refuses to settle on anything solid; the guitar and vocals sustain it until the track returns to a psychedelic rock sound.While it can be enjoyed for what it is, 1960s psychedelic rock, it gives no indication of the peak reached by their subsequent work, which would earn them a place in the Italian progressive rock scene before Marc, their singer and guitarist, left for Stockholm to pursue a career as a painter and graphic artist.

items.body:
Hot on the heels of their ‘Junglist!’ set, Soul Jazz reload their anthem-studded 2007 comp, packing early-mid ‘90s hardcore and ragga jungle heat by M-Beat & General Levy, Ragga Twins, SUAD, Cutty Ranks x DJ SS.

‘Rumble In The Jungle’ tells the story of jungle’s rapid evolution from mutant hip hop x dancehall in the late ’80s, via hardcore, to its hugely distinctive ragga and jump-up phase of the mid ‘90s. It’s a baga sounds that successive waves of producers have attempted to emulate ever since, but simply doesn’t get better than the OG tackle, as Soul Jazz well know.

The Ragga Twins understandably dominate the set with three bullets, the foundational, acid dancehall rap of ‘Ragga Trip’, sped-up fast rap steez of ‘Illegal Gunshot’, both from 1990, plus the ragga techno of ‘Tan So Back’ (1992), which all sparks so many dances and imaginations BITD. Shut Up and Dance, who issued all the above, are also on board, but with the gummy 2000 garage of ‘No Doubt’, which is hardly a standard, but does show how the sound had muted 10 years later.

The rest is all dead solid as a primer for inquisitive junglists/junglettes, firing General Levy’s alternative national anthem ‘Incredible’ and the murderous DJ SS remix of Cutty Ranks’ ‘Limb By Limb’, beside lesser known but wicked zingers such as DJ massive’s clattering hardcore rufige in ‘Final Conflict’, a deep fried steppa by The Source, and of course X Project’s deadly ramp of Beenie Man & Barrington Levy’s ‘Under Mi Sensi’.
items._cn_summary: Soul Jazz厂牌重新发行了这张2007年合辑的20周年版，梳理了丛林音乐从80年代末的变种嘻哈与dancehall，经由hardcore阶段，发展到90年代中期独具特色的ragga与jump-up风格的脉络。Ragga Twins的三首早期作品占据主导地位，包括1990年的dancehall rap《Ragga Trip》和快速说唱的《Illegal Gunshot》，以及1992年的ragga techno《Tan So Back》。此外收录了General Levy的另类国歌《Incredible》、Cutty Ranks经DJ SS混音的《Limb By Limb》remix，以及DJ Massive的hardcore rufige作品《Final Conflict》等。虽然作为丛林乐历史入门合辑选曲扎实，但该类型与用户关注的实验、前卫、学院派爵士、当代古典等口味相距甚远，整体仍属主流舞曲范畴的怀旧再版。

items.body:
4AD re-master and press Pixies' 'Complete B Sides' compilation to vinyl for the first time with a full side of bonus live recordings - 25 years after its first release, featuring their version of Peter Ivers and David Lynch's 'In Heaven' and Neil Young's 'I've Been Waiting For You', among others.

Pixies might not be the band they used to be, but you can't fuck with their original 4AD run, that ended unceremoniously in 1991 after the release of the misunderstood 'Trompe Le Monde'. 'Complete B-Sides' hoovers up the remaining tracks that filled out their run of singles, the covers, live recordings and alternate versions that any Pixies fan will need to remind them how good the band used to be before they reformed. This new version, that's been remastered from the original tapes by Kevin Vanbergen, is billed as a companion to the 'Live at the BBC' reissue. Presented with new art from designer Chris Bigg, it's also been filled out with a fourth side of additional live tracks.
